body:
I was diagnosed with type 1 bipolar in June 2013, after a manic episode. I'm currently on lamotrigine (lamictal aka lamictin aka epitec) 200mg a day.
Setting: outside in the mountains, then moved to room
My friend and I made a batch brownies with about 10g of low quality weed, we used oil to make the brownies. This is the second time I had ate brownies, I went for a rather large piece and that day I hadnt ate a alot of other food.
It was 17h00 when I ate the piece in the computer room, we then went for a walk into the mountains to meet some friends for a puff puff pass session. My friend hadnt ate any of the brownie it was only me. I have very little experience with weed so I didnt know what to expect. We reached the mountain and waited a while for the other friends to meet up.
I started to feel the buzz at about 17h45, it was nice and it quickly started to get more intense. I started doing silly things. I was also laughing alot, kinda like a drunk feeling, I was completey smashed, very high, laughing alot and saying stupid things. We then went inside and it started to get heavier, it felt like my head was about to explode
it felt like my head was about to explode
almost like a triangle was forming in my head, it was a weird sensation, I was very high to the point that I wanted to come down. I wasnt really enjoying it anymore and I told my friend to write down something along the lines of:  I never want to take such a high dose again. I then just lied down and looked at things in the room, I was geting these weird shivers and I had a very confused look on my face and my friend said my eyes were rolling in a funny way,  I read online that one can in a way overdose where one is unable to move or talk and I was definitely in that state. I just went to sleep at about 23h00 still quite high.
I woke up the next morning feeling confused and a little light headed, it wasnt per say unpleasant but I was glad the high was over.
